title: Focus: Hypnosis
description:
If you’re listening to this file, I expect that you’re already quite familiar with my Focus Training file. Much like that file, this file is designed to train your focus. Specifically, your focus towards hypnosis. It’s my aim to hypnotise you, and to help you find the feeling of hypnosis easier to get back to in the future.

We are training your hypnotic muscle.

This is an aphantasia-friendly file with no visualisation exercises. Instead, you'll be encouraged to explore hypnosis through focus, attention, and behavioural responses, including temporarily acting as though you're already hypnotised.

As always, this file is an erotic hypnosis fantasy and is best enjoyed with an understanding of subject agency. For more information on subject agency, MuttHypno has an excellent and comprehensive writing on Building Subject Agency
author: Lambellina
